data.one_liner: Provides shake animations, animated text, custom popup menus, and animated buttons in Flutter.
data.what_it_does: This package offers various animation components including widget shake effects, character-level text animations, bottom round flow menus, animated status buttons, vertical pop-up menus, and draggable floating action buttons.
use_when: You need to add a shake or wobble effect to arbitrary widgets or text.
You want custom animated menu layouts like bottom round flow menus or vertical popup buttons.
You require interactive animated buttons and draggable floating action buttons.
avoid_when: You are looking for a complete, mainstream UI kit like Material or Cupertino.
You need state management, routing, or networking solutions.
strengths: Ready-to-use custom animated widgets and menus.
Supports multiple shake animation types such as skew, random, and directional.
weaknesses: Documentation and examples are primarily in Chinese.
License type is unknown on pub.dev.
data.setup_notes: No special native setup or permissions documented.
data.minimal_example:
ShakeAnimationWidget(
  shakeAnimationController: _shakeAnimationController,
  shakeAnimationType: ShakeAnimationType.SkewShake,
  child: RaisedButton(
    child: Text('Test'),
    onPressed: () => _shakeAnimationController.start(),
  ),
)
